title: Service
description: Adds a service on BaseApi for one backend entity (Link Loom contract: GET <endpoint>/<queryselector>, POST, PATCH, DELETE) with list, read, add, edit and remove, and its test. `add entity` already writes one for its CRUD.

domain.description: Domain in kebab-case, as in the backend

endpoint.description: Backend path under VITE_APP_BACKEND_URL. Defaults to /<domain>/<entity>

scope.description: organization: list() asks for the records of an organization (queryselector organization-id)

calls.description: Actions the backend exposes as POST <endpoint>/<action> with { id }; each becomes a method
